I can do the deep-dive. High-level things I want to validate on the call:
1) Exact traffic profile (peak QPS, avg token length, expected session concurrency).
2) Persistence / KV cache requirements and whether they have any long-tail contexts that we should keep in-cache.
3) Data residency: confirm which datasets must remain inside their VPC vs. what can be pseudonymized and sent to our runtime.
4) Authentication and key management — if they need KMS/HSM integration we should surface potential lead times.
5) Latency SLO expectations and acceptable tradeoffs (batching vs single-request latency).

Availability: Tue 12/14 10:00-11:00 PT works for me. If they want a lighter touch, I can do a 20-min slot Tue 12/14 09:30-09:50 PT.

I attached a short pre-call checklist I use to speed the discovery: it includes a one-pager of the VPC network diagram we should request and a list of logs/retention questions. Also flagged the items that will affect timeline (KMS/HSM, SOC2 questionnaire turnaround).

If we want to be conservative on the pricing ask, I agree we can offer a small credit for the pilot but let's keep the ask for timeline firm.

- Diego
